captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric book page holder, designed to be worn on the thumb to help keep a book open with one hand. It consists of a central cylindrical ring for the thumb, flanked by two symmetrical, hollow, wing-like extensions pointing outwards. The wings are constructed as hollowed triangular outlines with internal reinforcing ribs, ensuring a lightweight yet sturdy design. The entire object has a uniform height and smooth, rounded outer edges.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric book page holder (book ring) in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a central cylindrical thumb ring of adjustable radius and wall thickness, flanked by two symmetric hollow wing structures that flare outwards at a customizable angle to hold pages flat. Include internal reinforcing ribs (additional structures) inside the hollow wings, and support custom text engraving on the front flat surfaces of both wings.
captions.factory: The design is built around a central `cylinder` representing the thumb ring, which is hollowed out using a `difference` operation. The symmetrical wings are created by a custom `wing` module that uses a `difference` between two `hull` operations of three cylinders to create a hollow triangular outline. Internal structural ribs are added using an `additionalStructur` module, which intersects a `hull` shape with concentric cylindrical walls. These wings and ribs are translated, rotated, mirrored, and combined with the central ring using `union`, while text is engraved on the front faces using the `write` library.
